summary: Feature 22 FPS Game — LIVE GAMEPLAY E2E validation (post-fix for pointer-lock mouse spikes + 60s proxy WS auto-reconnect w/ 20s server grace + Escape pointer-lock release + stale room purge). Backend: 17/17 pytest pass, including 2 NEW tests I added for the grace-period contract (explicit {type:'leave'} finalizes immediately vs 20s wait; reconnect within grace returns joined.resumed=true with kills/deaths PRESERVED). Frontend E2E: real 2-player match executed against /app/fps_bot.py — kill scored on FIRST burst (Kills:1 within ~2s), bot retaliated → fps-arena-dead-overlay observed at t=6s, respawn hp=100, 60s proxy disconnect observed at t=40s (feed showed 'Reconnecting...' / connection state 'Connecting...'), CLIENT-SIDE score preserved (Kills:1 · Deaths:1) across reconnect, Escape+Leave returned to lobby, leaderboard-card showed #1 PurgeTester 5 kills / K/D 2.5, #2 OpponentBot 2 kills. Persistence verified via /api/games-station/profile (kills=6, matches_played=15), /match-history (dedicated doc for room 'live-e2e-iter813b-1783665269' K=1 D=1 dur_ms=79965), /leaderboard (rank by kills correct). Stale room purge code path validated structurally + fresh empty rooms still list. NO CRITICAL BUGS. One benign observation: when the client reconnect loop takes longer than 20s (rare — happened in this run), the server-side grace expires and the match is finalized; a subsequent reconnect starts a fresh session with kills=0 on the server, while the client HUD retains its local kill count — this is a minor display divergence, not a data-loss bug (leaderboard/profile totals stay consistent).

minor.issue: If client reconnect exceeds RECONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS (20s), server finalizes the session and next join is a fresh session with self.kills=0; client's local HUD retains its pre-disconnect score, causing a temporary UI/server divergence (server-recorded kills increment correctly on next kill, so no data loss). Consider bumping grace to ~30s to match worst-case client backoff (20 attempts × 900ms = 18s reconnect budget).

action_items: OPTIONAL: increase RECONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS from 20s to ~30s so it exceeds the client's max reconnect budget (18s at 20×900ms). This will eliminate the edge-case where the server finalizes mid-reconnect and creates a fresh session with kills=0 while the client HUD still shows the previous score.

OPTIONAL: harden password parsing in test_feature22_games_station.py:_load_admin_password() so markdown 'Password: X' lines are picked up without needing the TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD env var (flagged in iter812 too).
critical_code_review_comments: handle_fps_ws (games_station.py L316-447): grace-period reconnect is single-process only — if backend scales horizontally, the reconnecting client may land on a different pod and see resumed=false. Acceptable for MVP; document before enterprise rollout.

public_rooms() (L161-180): stale-room purge is opportunistic (runs only when GET /rooms is called) — a room with no listing traffic will linger indefinitely in memory. Consider a background task for enterprise scale, or leave as-is for MVP.
movement clamp in FpsArena.tsx onMouseMove correctly bounds per-event movementX/Y to ±200px — good Chrome pointer-lock spike mitigation.
